brennic.name: Brennic the Red

garran.name: Garran Stonehand

iskar.name: Iskar Windborn
iskar.bio: A steppe rider who believed Rome's promise of citizenship. He hates the collar, the tents that obey it, and everyone who plays by its rules; he wants a fifth tent that answers to no one.

sadruba.name: Elder Sadruba
sadruba.bio: Twenty years in the camp, still burning. She picks the Ember Tent's entrant by blood and Pit results and nothing else.

ophel.name: Elder Ophel

never: acts on a rumour he did not start

ophel.bio: Keeps the Tide Tent's ledger of debts and the camp's best information. Commissions most of the schemes that are never traced back.

ruadh.name: Elder Ruadh

tics: talks about the harvest beyond the Door

ruadh.bio: Holds the Stone Tent together with bread and patience. Believes endurance outlasts the Romans.

kesh.name: Elder Kesh

never: picks a side before it wins

kesh.bio: An old nomad who trades with the Lanista and with everyone else. Tolerates Iskar because he brings in hands.

corvo.name: Corvo
corvo.bio: Was the Ember Tent's next entrant until the new Fire mage arrived. Same rank as the player; the slot cannot hold both.

nysa.name: Nysa

nysa.bio: Charming, quick, and the best liar in the camp. Cassia's same-rank rival for the Tide Tent's slot.

senna.name: Senna
senna.bio: Proud and careful, the Stone Tent's best young fighter until Garran came. Respects strength from any tent.

lio.name: Lio
lio.bio: Reckless, likeable, owes money to half the camp. Iskar's same-rank rival in the Gale Tent.

quill.name: Old Quill

never: says what he knows for free

quill.bio: A deserter from the Roman arcane college that built the Door. Knows what the Wardstones drink. Nobody listens to him.

septima.name: Warden Septima
septima.bio: The arcane warden whose salt-wards keep the camp's collars locked. Stops violence; punishes the caught, not the guilty.

venno.name: Lanista Aulus Venno
